episode.title: THE FORGOTTEN KINGDOM — SCREENPLAY (REVISION v1)
episode.logline: Dry British fantasy satire with slapstick visual timing

visual_principles: Pixar-style dimensional staging with appealing shapes and readable silhouettes.
Shape language and color carry the joke and the beat.
global_rules.color_palette: Saturated primaries balanced by neutral stone; teal-and-amber contrast.
global_rules.materials: Slightly exaggerated surface response; moss reads as soft velvet, metal as toy-like.
global_rules.geometry: Rounded, appealing forms; proportions slightly compressed for charm.
global_rules.character_design: Appealing cartoon proportions; expressive eyes and readable gestures.
global_rules.environment_design: Readable stage-like space with clear foreground, midground and background planes.
global_rules.lighting: Soft key with broad fill, colored bounce, gentle rim for silhouette separation.
global_rules.camera_language: 50mm-equivalent, slightly low camera for hero staging, smooth moves.
global_rules.composition: 50mm-equivalent, slightly low camera for hero staging, smooth moves.
global_rules.atmosphere: Soft key with broad fill, colored bounce, gentle rim for silhouette separation.
global_rules.accuracy_requirements: Preserve script-specified character identity, clothing, props and location. Do not invent story facts.
restrictions: Do not change character identity, clothing or proportions between shots.
Do not introduce locations, props or characters absent from the script.
Do not present inferred staging as explicit script fact.

scenes.heading: INT. FORGOTTEN CITADEL THRONE ROOM - MORNING
explicit_facts: Action text: Sunbeams slice through mossy gothic arches. SIR PIP (20s, earnest squire in oversized dented pauldrons) polishes a rusted bronze crown with a turnip cloth. Beside him, GLOOP (translucent emerald slime familiar wearing a tiny monocle) bubbles skeptically.
Action text: Behold, Gloop! According to the Royal Inventory of 842, whoever buffs the Crown of Eldoria inherits the entire Kingdom... and its tax exemptions.
Action text: And according to the foreclosure notice nailed to the drawbridge, we owe the Stone Golem three hundred turnips by noon.
